title: unified-rollouts: observability + telemetry for weighted shadow & canary auto-rollback
author: Diego Morales
description: Adds end-to-end observability and telemetry hooks for weighted shadow + canary rollout paths and the auto-rollback decision engine. Motivation: customers running mixed traffic strategies (weighted canary + shadow probing) lacked signal granularity to confidently trigger automated rollbacks without frequent false positives. This PR emits new composite metrics, per-variant latency histograms, shadow mismatch counters and trace correlation tags; wires those metrics into new dashboards and alert rules; and improves the autorollback engine to include quorum-based composite scoring and metric matching windows. Also adds e2e integration tests and stability guards to prevent premature rollbacks caused by transient infra noise. Backwards-compatible: rollout config schema is extended with optional telemetry knobs and a default migration path is provided.

release_notes: Improved observability and telemetry for weighted shadow and canary rollouts: new per-variant latency histograms (p50/p95), shadow mismatch counters, composite rollback scoring with quorum windows, dashboards and alert rules, and e2e stability guards. Backwards-compatible config extensions; no breaking changes.
rollback_policy_changes: Introduce composite scoring: combines latency, error-rate, and shadow-mismatch with configurable weights
Add quorum window (default=3) to require sustained violations before triggering auto-rollback
Expose telemetry knobs in rollout schema: sampling_rate, metric_weights, quorum_window
testing_steps: Run make test-unit to validate unit tests
Run scripts/local-rollout-debug.sh against local dev cluster to simulate weighted shadow traffic
Trigger e2e suite: CI pipeline ci/pipelines/rollouts-e2e.yml
Use observability/dashboards/rollouts/weighted-shadow-canary.json in local Grafana to validate metric surfaces
notes: Migration: existing rollouts will keep prior behavior until telemetry knobs are added to rollout spec; default knobs provide safe conservative settings.
Performance: metrics emitter batches and samples to keep overhead <0.5% p50 latency for common workload in our performance tests.
Follow-ups: add adaptive quorum based on traffic volume (ENG-2260) and include SLI-based auto-tuning (ENG-2283).
